title: Adventure
author: Will Crowther & Don Woods; Glulx port by Daniel Fox Franke
license_quote: Open Adventure was released with permission from Don Woods under a BSD 2-Clause license, and this port retains those terms.
desc_en: Colossal Cave Adventure 2.5 (430 points), the original cave-crawling treasure hunt that started the genre.
desc_it: Colossal Cave Adventure 2.5 (430 punti), la caccia al tesoro nelle caverne da cui è nato il genere.

title: All Things Devours
author: Toby Ord (half sick of shadows)
license_quote: It is in the public domain and may thus be freely copied or modified.
desc_en: Sneak into a research lab to sabotage a time machine: a tight, unforgiving time-travel puzzle.
desc_it: Entra di nascosto in un laboratorio per sabotare una macchina del tempo: un rompicapo sui viaggi nel tempo, serrato e spietato.

title: Tristam Island
author: Hugo Labrande
license_quote: now open source and under a Creative Commons Zero licence
desc_en: Your plane crashes at sea and you drift to a deserted island: why did its people leave? An Infocom-style adventure.
desc_it: Il tuo aereo precipita in mare e approdi su un'isola deserta: perché i suoi abitanti se ne sono andati? Un'avventura in stile Infocom.

title: Spider and Web
author: Andrew Plotkin
license_quote: [Spider and Web] is copyright 1997-8 by Andrew Plotkin. It may be copied, distributed, and played freely.
desc_en: A captured spy tells an interrogator how he broke in, and nothing is quite as it seems. A classic.
desc_it: Una spia catturata racconta a chi la interroga come è entrata, e niente è come sembra. Un classico.

title: So Far
author: Andrew Plotkin
license_quote: It may be copied, distributed, and played freely.
desc_en: A current of air in a cramped theatre leads you into strange, dreamlike worlds.
desc_it: Una corrente d'aria in un teatro affollato ti porta in mondi strani, come in sogno.

title: A Change in the Weather
author: Andrew Plotkin
license_quote: It may be copied, distributed, and played freely.
desc_en: Walking away from a picnic you are caught in a country storm and must save a bridge. Short and tricky.
desc_it: Ti allontani da un picnic e un temporale ti sorprende: devi salvare un ponte. Breve e insidiosa.

title: Lists and Lists
author: Andrew Plotkin
license_quote: It may be copied, distributed, and played freely.
desc_en: A genie teaches you a small version of the LISP programming language, with puzzles to solve in code.
desc_it: Un genio ti insegna una versione ridotta del linguaggio LISP, con enigmi da risolvere programmando.

title: Shade
author: Andrew Plotkin
license_quote: SHADE may be distributed for free, but not sold or included in any for-profit collection without written permission from the author.
desc_en: A one-room game set in your apartment, the night before a trip to the desert.
desc_it: Un gioco in una sola stanza, il tuo appartamento, la notte prima di un viaggio nel deserto.

title: Delightful Wallpaper
author: Andrew Plotkin (as Edgar O. Weyrd)
license_quote: It may be distributed for free, but not sold or included in any for-profit collection without written permission from the author.
desc_en: A ghoulishly funny manor-house murder mystery, in which you are not the detective.
desc_it: Un giallo in una villa, macabro e divertente, in cui non sei tu il detective.

title: Dual Transform
author: Andrew Plotkin
license_quote: It may be distributed for free, but not sold or included in any for-profit collection without written permission from the author.
desc_en: One room, but not always the same one, and one object with more to it than it seems. Experiment.
desc_it: Una stanza, ma non sempre la stessa, e un solo oggetto che nasconde più di quanto sembri. Sperimenta.

title: Hoist Sail for the Heliopause and Home
author: Andrew Plotkin
license_quote: It may be distributed for free, but not sold or included in any for-profit collection without written permission from the author.
desc_en: A short far-future story of discovery, told through a ship sailing the solar wind.
desc_it: Un breve racconto di scoperta in un futuro lontano, su una nave che veleggia nel vento solare.

title: Cold Iron
author: Andrew Plotkin (as Lyman Clive Charles)
license_quote: It may be distributed for free, but not sold or included in any for-profit collection without written permission from the author.
desc_en: Your good axe has gone missing, and maybe the piskeys stole it. A short folk tale.
desc_it: La tua ascia è sparita e forse l'hanno rubata i folletti. Una breve fiaba popolare.

title: Bigger Than You Think
author: Andrew Plotkin
license_quote: It may be distributed for free, but not sold or included in any for-profit collection without written permission from the author.
desc_en: A choice-based riff inspired by xkcd's huge "Click and Drag" comic: type one of the key words of each passage (the bold ones in other interpreters).
desc_it: Una storia a scelte ispirata al gigantesco fumetto "Click and Drag" di xkcd: scrivi una delle parole chiave di ogni brano (in altri interpreti sono in grassetto).

title: Blue Chairs
author: Chris Klimas
license_quote: This source code is licensed under the Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial-ShareAlike 3.0 License (README of the source release; the story file is its compiled form)
desc_en: A strange party, a strange drink, and a night that turns into a surreal dream about love.
desc_it: Una festa strana, una bevanda strana e una notte che diventa un sogno surreale sull'amore.

title: Rover's Day Out
author: Jack Welch & Ben Collins-Sussman
license_quote: released it on the Creative Commons Attribution - Noncommercial - Share Alike 3.0 license
desc_en: Winner of IFComp 2009: a morning routine, a dog, and a spaceship on a 1200-degree exoplanet.
desc_it: Vincitore dell'IFComp 2009: la routine del mattino, un cane e un'astronave su un pianeta a 1200 gradi.
note: pictures removed (executable chunk only), an adaptation the licence allows (same licence)

title: Hoosegow
author: Ben Collins-Sussman & Jack Welch
license_quote: released under the 'Creative Commons Attribution - Noncommercial - Share Alike 3.0' license
desc_en: Wild West jailbreak: get yourself and your partner out of the hoosegow before the hanging at dawn.
desc_it: Evasione nel Far West: tira fuori te e il tuo socio dalla prigione prima dell'impiccagione all'alba.
note: pictures removed (executable chunk only), an adaptation the licence allows (same licence)

title: Pogoman GO!
author: Jack Welch & Ben Collins-Sussman
license_quote: The code is released under the 'Creative Commons Attribution - Noncommercial - Share Alike 3.0'
desc_en: No job, no family: time to catch every Pogoman in town. A satire of mobile gaming.
desc_it: Niente lavoro, niente famiglia: è ora di catturare tutti i Pogoman della città. Satira dei giochi per telefono.
note: pictures removed (executable chunk only), an adaptation the licence allows (same licence)

title: Book and Volume
author: Nick Montfort
license_quote: Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial-ShareAlike License 2.5 (IF Archive index entry of bookvol.z5)
desc_en: A sysadmin in a sprawling tech city, paged all night long. A satire of the always-on workplace.
desc_it: Un sistemista in una città tecnologica, chiamato dal cercapersone tutta la notte. Satira del lavoro sempre connesso.

title: Figaro
author: Victor Gijsbers
license_quote: It is released under the GNU Public License 3.0.
desc_en: A short experiment: before playing, you decide what the world is like at the start of the game.
desc_it: Un breve esperimento: prima di giocare decidi tu com'è il mondo all'inizio della partita.

title: Fate
author: Victor Gijsbers
license_quote: released under the GNU Public License version 2 or any later version
desc_en: A queen in labour, trapped in a hostile castle, sees her son's fate in a crystal ball. Dark and short.
desc_it: Una regina in travaglio, prigioniera in un castello ostile, vede il destino del figlio in una sfera di cristallo. Cupa e breve.

title: SpiritWrak
author: Daniel S. Yu
license_quote: you can redistribute it and/or modify it under the terms of the GNU General Public License
desc_en: Set in the world of Zork: recover the shattered Rod of the Ancients, up to the Implementors themselves.
desc_it: Ambientato nel mondo di Zork: recupera i pezzi della Verga degli Antichi, fino agli Implementatori.

title: The Art of Fugue
author: Victor Gijsbers, Jimmy Maher, Dorte Lassen & Johan
license_quote: licensed under the GNU General Public License version 3, or any later version
desc_en: Pure logic puzzles: four actors perform your commands, each with a growing delay, like the voices of a fugue.
desc_it: Puri enigmi logici: quattro attori eseguono i tuoi comandi con ritardi crescenti, come le voci di una fuga.

title: The Life (and Deaths) of Doctor M
author: Michael D. Hilborn
license_quote: "The Life (and Deaths) of Doctor M" by Michael D. Hilborn is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial-NoDerivs 3.0 Unported License. (README.txt in the IF Archive release zip)
desc_en: You land in an endless, windy landscape and piece together the life of a mad scientist.
desc_it: Atterri in un paesaggio sconfinato e ventoso e ricostruisci la vita di uno scienziato pazzo.

title: Changes
author: David Given
license_quote: The game binary and source code are redistributable under the terms of the Creative Commons BY-ND license.
desc_en: Elysia, a new Earth found by a starship on a thousand-year voyage, and you are not quite what you were.
desc_it: Elysia, una nuova Terra trovata da un'astronave in viaggio da mille anni, e tu non sei più quello di prima.

title: Risorgimento Represso
author: Michael J. Coyne
license_quote: You are free: to copy, distribute, display the source code [...] to make derivative works (LICENSE of the source release; the story file is its compiled form)
desc_en: A bored student falls through a portal into a wizard's library and becomes his accidental apprentice. Comedy.
desc_it: Uno studente annoiato cade in un portale nella biblioteca di un mago e ne diventa l'apprendista per sbaglio. Commedia.

title: Beyond (Aldilà)
author: Roberto Grassi, Paolo Lucchesi & Alessandro Peretti
license_quote: Beyond e' rilasciato sotto sotto i termini della licenza CreativeCommons Attribuzione - Non commerciale - Non opere derivate versione 2.5. (README of the IF Archive release)
desc_en: A mysterious death and a secret to reveal, among glass boxes, in the world beyond. Text-only version.
desc_it: Una morte misteriosa e un segreto da svelare, tra scatole di vetro, nell'aldilà. Versione solo testo.

title: La Pietra della Luna
author: Paolo Lucchesi
license_quote: I file luna.gblorb e luna.zblorb sono distribuiti secondo i termini della Gnu Public License (GPL) versione 2 (README of the IF Archive release)
desc_en: A fantasy mystery: a young inquisitor investigates what hides in the forest nights of the Nigat valley.
desc_it: Un mistero fantasy: un giovane investigatore dell'inquisizione scopre cosa nascondono le notti nella foresta della valle di Nigat.

title: Villa Morgana
author: Paolo Lucchesi
license_quote: I file villa.zblorb e villa.gblorb sono distribuiti secondo i termini della Gnu Public License (GPL) versione 2 (README of the IF Archive release)
desc_en: Locked in an old mansion, looking for a friend: an introduction to text adventures with a step-by-step guide.
desc_it: Chiuso in un vecchio palazzo, alla ricerca di un'amica: un'introduzione alle avventure testuali con una guida passo passo.

title: Le Lande di Erisvalle
author: Paolo Lucchesi
license_quote: I file erisvalle.gblorb, erisvalle_nomouse.gblorb e erisvalle_acv.ulx sono distribuiti secondo i termini della Gnu Public License (GPL) vers. 2 (README of the release zip)
desc_en: Explore the far lands of Erisvalle in search of seven relics of an ancient kingdom and seven runes of power.
desc_it: Esplora le lontane Lande di Erisvalle alla ricerca delle sette reliquie dell'antico regno e delle sette rune del potere.

title: Salvate lo Stregatto!
author: Marco Vallarino
license_quote: Il file Stregatto.inf è il listato del programma, scritto in Inform 6, rilasciato con licenza CC-BY-SA 4.0 (Stregatto_leggimi.txt; the story file is its compiled form)
desc_en: The Cheshire Cat, mascot of a games club, is missing: find it before it becomes a fur coat. Short comedy.
desc_it: Lo Stregatto, mascotte di un'associazione ludica, è sparito: ritrovalo prima che diventi una pelliccia. Breve commedia.

title: Save the Cheshire Cat!
author: Marco Vallarino
license_quote: This work is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-ShareAlike 4.0 International License (read-me in the IF Archive stregatto.zip and the in-game LICENSE command)
desc_en: English version of Salvate lo Stregatto!: find the missing cat before it is turned into a fur coat.
desc_it: Versione inglese di Salvate lo Stregatto!: ritrova il gatto scomparso prima che diventi una pelliccia.

title: ZenFactor Spa
author: Tristano Ajmone
license_quote: ZenFactor Spa, by Tristano Ajmone. Public domain. (IF Archive index, games/zcode/italian)
desc_en: A short tutorial adventure: visit a company in Turin to find out what text adventures are about.
desc_it: Una breve avventura tutorial: visiti un'azienda di Torino per scoprire cosa sono le avventure testuali.

title: Edge Valley Bigfoot Society
author: NegSec
license_quote: Edge Valley Bigfoot Society, by NegSec. Version 1.0.2 (Release 1 / Serial number 251022). General Public License. (IF Archive index, games/glulx)
desc_en: A smarter-than-usual Bigfoot is caught by hunters: can he escape their facility? Six endings.
desc_it: Un Bigfoot più sveglio del solito viene catturato dai cacciatori: riuscirà a fuggire? Sei finali.
